text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I check my emails and get ready for work. I start work at nine and follow a regular schedule until five, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either going for a run or doing a workout at home. In the evening, I cook dinner, relax with a book, and plan the next day. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel organised, healthy, and full of energy.
